services.name: Sail the World Your Way
services.desc: Sail upstream along the legendary Yangtze River on a 5‑day journey from Yichang to Chongqing, discovering the breathtaking landscapes of the Three Gorges and some of China’s greatest engineering achievements. Cruise through the dramatic scenery of Xiling Gorge, Wu Gorge, and Qutang Gorge, while exploring iconic sites such as the Three Gorges Dam and the world‑famous ship lift. Along the way, step ashore to visit historic and cultural landmarks including White Emperor City, the Three Gorges Summit, and unique attractions in Fuling.
